title: Harmonia: Ashes of Draconia
description: A dark fantasy D&D 5e campaign centered on the expansionist Harmonian Empire, the fallen Dragonborn nation of Draconia, and the vengeance of Valerion Kragros. The story follows Kragros and Byakko as they move from exile-born wanderers to war-shaping heroes, confronting imperial conquest, anti-sorcerer fanaticism, eldritch horror, and the legacy of a destroyed homeland.
